clips.title: The story
paras: Mor'Ladim stalks the grounds of Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood, a vengeful skeletal warrior. He was once Morgan Ladimore, a noble knight who lost his family and was overcome by grief and madness, rising in undeath to kill those who cross his path.

Before Raven Hill feared his name, Morgan Ladimore defended the helpless from Grand Hamlet, now called Darkshire. He married Lys at eighteen, and they raised three children in peace until war called him north. During the Third War, Morgan marched with Uther the Lightbringer to Lordaeron. There he witnessed the fall of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the spread of Kel'Thuzad's plague, and Uther's death.

Morgan found no peace in the grave. Guilt over the innocent blood he had shed and suffocating grief stirred his corrupted remains from the earth as a hulking skeletal revenant. Travelers and the Night Watch soon learned to fear the name Mor'Ladim. With his ancestral blade Archeus, he patrols the misty graves, cutting down beasts and unwary travelers who stray near his resting place.
